test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Avik runs at a speed of 8 metres per second. How many kilometres will Avik cover in 24 minutes if he continues running at the same speed?
solution:
**Given:**

Running speed (S) = 8 m/s

Time (T) = 24 minutes = 24 × 60s = 1440 s.

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance(D)/Time

**Calculations:**

S = D/T

⇒ 8 = D/1440

⇒ D = 8 × 1440 = 11520 m

According to the question,

⇒ D = 11520/1000 = 11.52 km.

**∴ Avik will cover a distance of 11.52 km.**
